ruleDefinitions.name: Arbitrary MSI Download Via Devinit.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a certain command line flag combination used by "devinit.exe", which can be abused as a LOLBIN to download arbitrary MSI packages on a Windows system

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-t\\ msi\\-install\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-i\\ http.*"))
